## Safety / Accuracy Checklist

- [ ] No commercial tool code, UI, icons, wording, protocols, or private behavior copied.
- [ ] No secrets, local databases, raw logs, raw CSV files, or generated binaries committed.
- [ ] Unavailable metrics remain N/A or clearly marked unavailable; no fake values.
- [ ] New external commands go through CommandRunner.
- [ ] Diagnostics and exports remain sanitized.
